method: Each detected notehead center was matched against observed measure spans for its staff and the page's candidate staff-system mapping. A head was counted as uniquely anchorable only when exactly one measure span contained its center. Boundaries are inclusive on both adjacent measure regions, so a notehead center exactly on a shared boundary is correctly counted as ambiguous.
limitations: This measures geometric anchorability only, not notehead detection precision or recall.
Staff-system assignments remain candidates; in this analysis several staves remain separate system candidates.
Measure spans are observed geometric intervals, not confirmed musical bar numbers.
No pitch, key signature, accidental, duration, voice, or audio correctness is measured.
The one ambiguous boundary is retained for review rather than forced into either adjacent measure.

ambiguous_boundary_example.handling: kept unresolved; not assigned to either adjacent measure
